newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait wants end to Iraqi aggressive intentions.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait wants end to Iraqi aggressive intentions.

text.p: Kuwait on Monday called on world states to put an end to what it called Iraq's provocative practices and aggressive intentions.
"The Iraqi regime is still seeking to implement its aggressive plans and intentions," Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah said during an emergency cabinet session.

A government statement read on state radio said the emir "called on the international community to shoulder its responsibilties in facing that (Iraqi) regime and put an end to its provocative practices and its continuous threats to peace and stability in the region."
Iraq last week warned Kuwait against allowing U.S. Stealth warplanes to deploy in the small Gulf Arab state.
